## What is this about?

<!-- generated by aider + aider-skills + skill create-blog-entry-what-is-this-about -->

The sw-dev-agent-framework is a Python‑based framework that enables AI agents to carry out the full software development lifecycle. It provides a set of TDD‑driven skills—such as requirements gathering, architecture design, test‑first implementation, code review, and release—each exposed through a unified CLI orchestrator. The framework includes a REST API, an OpenAPI contract, and an optional MCP server for tool integration, as well as container support via Podman. Developers can invoke the pipeline with simple commands or integrate it into CI/CD pipelines to automate project scaffolding, testing, and deployment. The system is useful for teams and AI‑assisted development workflows that want reproducible, test‑first software creation.
